test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement(s) is / are correct about Prarthana Samaj?

A. Prarthana Samaj was a movement for religious and social reforms.

B. Prarthana Samaj was founded in 1867 by the Dadoba Pandurang and his brother Atmaram Pandurang.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 Both A and B**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Prarthana Samaj** was indeed a movement for religious and social reforms. It aimed at rational worship and social reforms such as the abolition of caste system and the promotion of women's education.
 
• **Prarthana Samaj was founded in 1867 by Dadoba Pandurang and his brother Atmaram Pandurang.** The society was influenced by the Brahmo Samaj movement in Bengal and aimed to make people believe in one God and worship only one God.
 
• The Prarthana Samaj worked towards the betterment of society by fighting against social evils like child marriage, untouchability, and the dowry system.
 
• It also laid emphasis on the education of women and the upliftment of the oppressed classes.
 
• Both statements A and B are correct and provide a comprehensive overview of the objectives and founding of the Prarthana Samaj.
